classification.reason: The two differing charge amounts match the KB's documented explanation for mid-cycle proration plus renewal (not the same-amount/same-day case flagged as a billing error), and the customer is asking for clarification, not a refund.

draft.reply: {"reply": "Hi, thanks for reaching out! Two charges in the same month usually happen when your workspace's member count crosses a plan threshold mid-cycle -- that triggers a prorated charge for the added member(s) in addition to your regular renewal charge, so you end up with two separate line items instead of one. You can confirm this by going to Settings > Billing > Invoices, where each charge should show as its own line item with a description. If you check there and the two charges turn out to be for the exact same amount on the exact same day, that would actually be a billing error rather than proration, so let us know and we'll escalate it for you. Otherwise, let me know if the invoice breakdown doesn't make sense and I'm happy to help further!", "citations": ["billing_faq.md#Q:-I-was-charged-twice-this-month,-what-happened?"]}

verification.notes: Citation is accurate and content-matched, no unbacked claims, no refund/discount promised, tone is professional; classifier's needs_human_approval=false stands.
